answers.genPolicy:df0871034bf3d1fd055c65522c54ab:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < Device | ... > $ UserX 'approach' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < Cloud | 'key' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | 'key' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ Cloud 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth',Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY) if 1 == 1 .
[B4] < Cloud | 'key' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY)
=> < Cloud | 'key' : Secret , Device : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ... > < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ Cloud 'sendCommand' RelayUser | (Device ; encrypt('auth',Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY) if 1 == 1 .
[B5] < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L)
=> < RelayUser | 'near' : Device , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' Device | L .
[B6] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > < Device | 'command' : L , ... >
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > < Device | 'command' : L , ... > .
[B7] < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : L , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'forwardCommand' Device | (L)
=> < CachingRelayUser | 'near' : Device , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ... > $ CachingRelayUser 'proxyCommand' Device | L .
[B8] < Device | 'key' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth',Secret) ; 'share' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'key' : Secret , 'trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ... > .
[B9] < Device | 'key' : Secret , 'trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ... > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' Device | (encrypt('auth',Secret) ; 'revoke' ; UserY)
=> < Device | 'key' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > .
